title: Abonelik durumu rozetleri
purpose: HomeSubscriptionScreen shows plan badge (Aktif/Deneme/Iptal) in header area. Tapping badge opens this screen with plan details, active add-ons list, and paywall explanation for restricted content. AC-FR-E2-02-01/02/03.

loading.description: Skeleton badge placeholder in header while subscription data loads from entitlement cache.

ready.description: Plan badge (Aktif green / Deneme amber / Iptal red) visible in header. Tapping opens detail sheet: plan name, renewal date, active add-ons list. AC-FR-E2-02-01/02 satisfied. Locked content tap shows paywall sheet with restriction reason. AC-FR-E2-02-03 satisfied.

empty.description: No subscription on record: show 'Plana Katil' banner with Upgrade CTA linking to subscription flow.

error.description: Badge shows neutral 'Plan?' state with retry. Full detail screen shows 'Abonelik bilgisi yuklenemedi. Tekrar Dene'.

offline.description: Cached subscription status shown. Badge tint reflects last known state. Add-on list uses cache. Upgrade CTA disabled offline.
